title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Electrocardiography for Early Diagnosis of Thyrotoxic Periodic Paralysis
summary: An ECG deep-learning system estimated hypokalemia and supported thyrotoxic periodic paralysis diagnosis, with a separated validation cohort and a prospective clinical evaluation. Methods describe ECG12Net-derived models, development/validation cohorts and prospective workflow; Results report diagnostic performance and the limited prospective cohort.
